id: 08_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Near Miss Scenario
title: 飘带向外飘了
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/08_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Near Miss Scenario.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/08_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Near Miss Scenario/src.py

points.K4: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门外，门框上一根小飘带
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands outside a laboratory door with a small ribbon tape hanging from the top of the door frame.
shots.narration: 这一课是个情景题：飘带向外飘了。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个大问号牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a big question mark sign and tilts its head.
shots.narration: 听完故事，请你一起来想答案。

shots.scene: 清晨，小研拎着包走到实验室门口
shots.prompt_en: Early morning light in a corridor; the female graduate student carrying a bag walks up to the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 想象一下：一天早上，你走进实验室。

shots.scene: 明亮的实验室，台面上有试剂瓶和小仪器
shots.prompt_en: A bright laboratory seen through the open door, with reagent bottles and small instruments on the benches. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里明亮安静，和平时一样。

shots.scene: 门一开，门框上的飘带向走廊方向飘出
shots.prompt_en: As the lab door opens, the ribbon tape on the door frame blows outward into the corridor. No people.
shots.narration: 可门口的飘带，却在向外飘。

shots.scene: 从实验室指向走廊的蓝色气流箭头
shots.prompt_en: Blue airflow arrows pointing from the lab out into the corridor. No people.
shots.narration: 这说明，空气正从实验室往外流。

shots.scene: 小研停在门口，抬头盯着飘带
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops at the doorway and stares up at the ribbon tape blowing outward.
shots.narration: 你停下脚步，盯着这根飘带。

shots.scene: 红色旋转警示灯特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a red rotating warning beacon light flashing on the wall.
shots.narration: 你知道，定向气流应该流进实验室。

shots.scene: 气流箭头从走廊流进实验室，飘带向内飘
shots.prompt_en: An icon of blue airflow arrows flowing from the corridor into the lab, with the ribbon tape bending inward. No people.
shots.narration: 正常时，飘带应该朝里飘。

shots.scene: 两张对比图：向内的箭头和向外的箭头，中间问号
shots.prompt_en: Two side-by-side icons: inward airflow arrows and outward airflow arrows, with a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 可今天，方向反了过来。

shots.scene: 一位穿白大褂、戴帽子的人背对镜头，走向实验室深处
shots.prompt_en: A person in a white lab coat and cap, seen from behind, walks deeper into the softly blurred laboratory.
shots.narration: 问题来了：这时，你该怎么做？

shots.scene: 门口的飘带依旧向外飘，警示灯一闪一闪
shots.prompt_en: The ribbon tape keeps blowing outward at the doorway while a red warning beacon flashes on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 飘带还在向外飘。

shots.scene: 小研头顶浮现一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: A big question mark floats above the female graduate student's head at the lab door.
shots.narration: 你该怎么做？

shots.scene: 欣欣对着镜头，竖起一根手指放在嘴边
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot faces the camera and puts one finger to its lips, as if asking for quiet thinking.
shots.narration: 先别急着往下看，停下来想一想。

shots.scene: 画面渐暗，只留一个沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: The screen slowly dims, leaving only an hourglass icon with falling sand in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 给自己一点时间，好好想想。

shots.scene: 小研在空白本子上列清单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes a list in a blank notebook, thinking hard.
shots.narration: 把你会采取的做法，一条条列出来。

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本更大的空白规程手册
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 本课面向实验室人员，
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 规程手册放大，旁边一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the blank procedure binder with a large green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不能代替你实验室自己的规程。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现向外飘的飘带图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a floating icon of a ribbon tape blowing outward.
shots.narration: 早上进门，飘带向外飘。

shots.scene: 向外的气流箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of blue airflow arrows pointing out of a door. No people.
shots.narration: 说明空气正往实验室外流。

shots.scene: 向内的气流箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of blue airflow arrows pointing into a door. No people.
shots.narration: 而定向气流，本该流进实验室。

shots.scene: 一个大问号图标
shots.prompt_en: A large question mark icon glowing in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 这时你该怎么做？

shots.scene: 欣欣对镜头眨眨眼
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot winks at the camera with a friendly smile.
shots.narration: 这道题，留给你自己找答案。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研在实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the female graduate student wave goodbye at the lab door under the ribbon tape.
shots.narration: 带着问题去思考，下次见！
